/*selectBuyerNoticeListCommon - 공통 공지사항 (전체 고객사 대상)*/
SELECT ROWNUM NUM, T.* FROM ( SELECT A.BID, A.BTYPE, A.COMPANY, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.COMPANY) COM_NAME_LOC, A.SUBJECT, A.REG_USER_NAME, A.REG_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REG_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY.MM.DD') AS REG_DATE_DIS, A.EXPOSE_TARGET, A.LCOUNT, A.IMAGE_KEY, A.IMPORTANT_FLAG, A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(A.CONTEXT, 4000, 1) AS CONTEXT, CASE WHEN R.BID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS READ_YN FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE A LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ R ON A.BID = R.BID AND A.BTYPE = R.BTYPE AND R.COM_CODE = #{st_company} AND R.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} WHERE A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.EXPOSE_TARGET IN ('BUY', 'ALL') AND A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'Y' AND (A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR (A.FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')))
AND (A.SUBJECT LIKE '%' || #{st_keyword} || '%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(A.CONTEXT, #{st_keyword}) > 0)
ORDER BY A.IMPORTANT_FLAG DESC, CASE WHEN R.BID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.REG_DATE DESC, A.BID DESC ) T

/*selectBuyerNoticeListCompany - 거래사별 공지사항 (특정 고객사 대상)*/
SELECT ROWNUM NUM, T.* FROM ( SELECT A.BID, A.BTYPE, A.COMPANY, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.COMPANY) COM_NAME_LOC, A.SUBJECT, A.REG_USER_NAME, A.REG_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REG_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY.MM.DD') AS REG_DATE_DIS, A.EXPOSE_TARGET, A.LCOUNT, A.IMAGE_KEY, A.IMPORTANT_FLAG, A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(A.CONTEXT, 4000, 1) AS CONTEXT, CASE WHEN R.BID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS READ_YN FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE A LEFT OUTER JOIN ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ R ON A.BID = R.BID AND A.BTYPE = R.BTYPE AND R.COM_CODE = #{st_company} AND R.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} WHERE A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.EXPOSE_TARGET IN ('BUY', 'ALL') AND A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'N' AND (A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR (A.FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT DT WHERE DT.BID = A.BID AND DT.BTYPE = A.BTYPE AND DT.COM_CODE = #{st_company} )
AND (A.SUBJECT LIKE '%' || #{st_keyword} || '%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(A.CONTEXT, #{st_keyword}) > 0)
ORDER BY A.IMPORTANT_FLAG DESC, CASE WHEN R.BID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.REG_DATE DESC, A.BID DESC ) T

/*selectBuyerNoticeDetail*/
SELECT A.BID, A.BTYPE, A.COMPANY, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.COMPANY) COM_NAME_LOC, A.SUBJECT, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(A.CONTEXT, 4000, 1) AS CONTEXT, A.REG_USER_ID, A.REG_USER_NAME, A.REG_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REG_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY.MM.DD') AS REG_DATE_DIS, A.REG_TIME, A.IMAGE_KEY, A.LCOUNT, A.FROM_DATE, A.TO_DATE, A.IMPORTANT_FLAG, A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG, A.EXPOSE_TARGET, A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE A WHERE A.BID = #{BID} AND A.BTYPE = #{BTYPE}

SELECT NVL(MAX(BID), 0) + 1 AS BID FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE WHERE BTYPE = #{BTYPE}
INSERT INTO ICOMBOARD_NOTICE ( BID, BTYPE, COMPANY, STATUS, SUBJECT, CONTEXT, REG_USER_ID, REG_USER_NAME, REG_DATE, REG_TIME, REG_DEP, REG_DEP_NAME, IMAGE_KEY, LCOUNT, OPEN_FLAG, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, IMPORTANT_FLAG, ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG, EXPOSE_TARGET, NOTICE_TYPE, ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{BID}, #{BTYPE}, #{COMPANY}, 'C', #{SUBJECT}, #{CONTEXT}, #{REG_USER_ID}, #{REG_USER_NAME}, #{REG_DATE}, #{REG_TIME}, #{REG_DEP}, #{REG_DEP_NAME}, #{IMAGE_KEY}, 0, 'N', REPLACE(#{FROM_DATE}, '/', ''), REPLACE(#{TO_DATE}, '/', ''), NVL(#{IMPORTANT_FLAG}, 'N'), NVL(#{ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG}, 'N'), 'BUY', NVL(#{NOTICE_TYPE}, 'CMN'), NVL(#{ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG}, 'N') )
mapper.update: UPDATE ICOMBOARD_NOTICE SET SUBJECT = #{SUBJECT}, CONTEXT = #{CONTEXT}, IMAGE_KEY = #{IMAGE_KEY}, FROM_DATE = REPLACE(#{FROM_DATE}, '/', ''), TO_DATE = REPLACE(#{TO_DATE}, '/', ''), ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = NVL(#{ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG}, 'N'), NOTICE_TYPE = NVL(#{NOTICE_TYPE}, 'CMN'), ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = NVL(#{ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG}, 'N') WHERE BID = #{BID} AND BTYPE = #{BTYPE}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT WHERE BID = #{BID} AND BTYPE = #{BTYPE}

/*selectBuyerInquiryDetail - KEPAVCDT VOC 상세*/
SELECT A.VC_NO, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC03' AND CODE = A.CLAIM_MASTER) AS CLAIM_TEXT, A.CLAIM_MASTER, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.PO_NO, A.REQ_REMARK, A.RECV_FLAG, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC02' AND CODE = A.RECV_FLAG) AS RECV_FLAG_TEXT, TO_CHAR(A.REQ_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS REQ_DATE_DIS, A.REQ_USER_ID, A.REQ_USER_NAME, A.REQ_USER_TEL, TO_CHAR(A.PH_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS PH_DATE_DIS, A.DS_REMARK_A, A.DS_REMARK_B, A.DS_REMARK_C, A.DF_REMARK, TO_CHAR(A.DF_DATE,'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DF_DATE_DIS, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.DS_USER_ID) AS DS_USER_NAME, A.RUB_TYPE, DECODE(A.RUB_TYPE,'A','매우만족','B','만족','C','보통','D','불만','F','매우불만','미평가') AS RUB_TEXT FROM KEPAVCDT A WHERE A.VC_NO = #{st_vc_no} AND A.BUYER = #{st_company}

SELECT CODE, TEXT1 AS CODE_NAME FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'VC03' AND CODE IN ('ZP','ZC','ZE','ZL','ZO','ZD','ZS','ZN') ORDER BY TEXT1

/*selectBuyerInternalNoticeDetail*/
SELECT A.BID, A.BTYPE, A.SUBJECT, A.CONTEXT, A.REG_USER_ID, A.REG_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REG_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY.MM.DD') AS REG_DATE_DIS, A.REG_TIME, A.IMAGE_KEY, A.LCOUNT, A.FROM_DATE, A.TO_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.FROM_DATE,'/',''),'.',''),'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY.MM.DD') AS FROM_DATE_DIS, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.TO_DATE,'/',''),'.',''),'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY.MM.DD') AS TO_DATE_DIS, A.OPEN_FLAG, A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.REG_USER_ID AND STATUS <> 'D') AS USER_NAME_LOC FROM BUYERBOARD A WHERE A.BID = #{BID} AND A.BTYPE = 'NTC' AND A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_byca_comorg_code} AND A.STATUS != 'D'

SELECT NVL(MAX(BID),0)+1 AS BID FROM BUYERBOARD WHERE BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{BYCA_COMORG_CODE}
INSERT INTO BUYERBOARD (BID, BTYPE, COM_CODE, BYCA_COMORG_CODE, STATUS, VID, PID, BLEVEL, ACL, LCOUNT, SORT, SUBJECT, CONTEXT, REG_USER_ID, REG_DATE, REG_TIME, REG_DEP, REG_DEP_NAME, IMAGE_KEY, PASSWORD, FROM_DATE, TO_DATE, OPEN_FLAG) VALUES (#{BID}, 'NTC', #{COM_CODE}, #{BYCA_COMORG_CODE}, 'C', #{BID}*10, #{BID}, 0, 'ALL', 0, '', #{SUBJECT}, #{CONTEXT}, #{REG_USER_ID}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #{REG_DEP}, #{REG_DEP_NAME}, #{IMAGE_KEY}, '', REPLACE(REPLACE(#{FROM_DATE},'/',''),'.',''), REPLACE(REPLACE(#{TO_DATE},'/',''),'.',''), 'Y')

/*insertBuyerInternalNoticeReadLog - BID 재사용 대비 upsert: 옛 로그가 있으면 READ_DATE를 현재일자로 갱신*/
MERGE INTO ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ T USING (SELECT #{bid} AS BID, 'NTC' AS BTYPE, #{comCode} AS COM_CODE, #{userId} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.BID = S.BID AND T.BTYPE = S.BTYPE AND T.COM_CODE = S.COM_CODE AND T.USER_ID = S.USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.READ_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (BID, BTYPE, COM_CODE, USER_ID, READ_DATE) VALUES (S.BID, S.BTYPE, S.COM_CODE, S.USER_ID, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))
mapper.select:
/*selectBuyerUnreadNoticeCount - 미확인 공지(일반:NOTICE_UNREAD) + 미확인 내부공지(INTERNAL_UNREAD) 종류별 + 합산(TOTAL_UNREAD)*/
SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN SRC = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NOTICE_UNREAD, /* 공지사항 탭(tabIndex=2) */ NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN SRC = 'I' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS INTERNAL_UNREAD, /* 내부 공지사항 탭(tabIndex=3) */ COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_UNREAD FROM ( /* 1. 공통 공지사항 (ICOMBOARD_NOTICE, ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG='Y') */ SELECT 'N' AS SRC, A.BID, A.BTYPE FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE A WHERE A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.EXPOSE_TARGET IN ('BUY', 'ALL') AND A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'Y' AND (A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR (A.FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ R WHERE R.BID = A.BID AND R.BTYPE = A.BTYPE AND R.COM_CODE = #{st_company} AND R.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ) AND SUBSTR(A.REG_DATE,1,6) >= '202605' UNION ALL /* 2. 거래사별 공지사항 (ICOMBOARD_NOTICE, ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG='N') */ SELECT 'N' AS SRC, A.BID, A.BTYPE FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE A WHERE A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.EXPOSE_TARGET IN ('BUY', 'ALL') AND A.OPEN_FLAG = 'Y' AND A.ALL_CUSTOMER_FLAG = 'N' AND (A.ALWAYS_SHOW_FLAG = 'Y' OR (A.FROM_DATE <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.TO_DATE >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'))) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_DT DT WHERE DT.BID = A.BID AND DT.BTYPE = A.BTYPE AND DT.COM_CODE = #{st_company} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ R WHERE R.BID = A.BID AND R.BTYPE = A.BTYPE AND R.COM_CODE = #{st_company} AND R.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ) AND SUBSTR(A.REG_DATE,1,6) >= '202605' UNION ALL /* 3. 내부 공지사항 (BUYERBOARD, BTYPE='NTC') */ SELECT 'I' AS SRC, A.BID, A.BTYPE FROM BUYERBOARD A WHERE A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BTYPE = 'NTC' AND A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = #{st_byca_comorg_code} AND SUBSTR(A.REG_DATE,1,6) >= '202605'
AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN REPLACE(REPLACE(A.FROM_DATE,'/',''),'.','') AND REPLACE(REPLACE(A.TO_DATE,'/',''),'.','')
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBOARD_NOTICE_READ R WHERE R.BID = A.BID AND R.BTYPE = 'NTC' AND R.COM_CODE = #{st_company} AND R.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND R.READ_DATE >= A.REG_DATE ) )
